name: rig-dev
description: Dev-only toolchain for the Rig kit repo (typecheck + tests). NOT vendored into consumer projects — install.sh copies only skills/, agents/, scripts/, smithers/ content. The 'pi' key additionally makes this repo installable as a pi package (pi install git:github.com/agent-rig/rig) — see docs/pi.md.

scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run test
